about.bio: Welcome to my portfolio. Here, I showcase functional, client-side applications built through AI-assisted engineering. Rather than commercial products, these projects serve as robust proofs-of-concept designed to operate independently without backend dependencies—acting as an advanced architectural sandbox for prototyping and evaluating new technologies.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: A selection of personal projects and tools that streamline my routine or bring me satisfaction. I’d love to hear your thoughts—feel free to send over any feedback or bugs!
